formulas.adj_o: Points scored per 100 possessions, adjusted for the defenses faced and for home court (BettorDay ratings v0).
formulas.adj_d: Points allowed per 100 possessions, adjusted for the offenses faced and for home court; lower is better (BettorDay ratings v0).
formulas.adj_em: Adjusted offense minus adjusted defense (BettorDay ratings v0).
formulas.adj_tempo: Possessions per 40 minutes, adjusted for the opponents' pace (BettorDay ratings v0).
formulas.possessions: Each game's possessions are the average of the two teams' box-score possession counts.
formulas.four_factors: eFG% = (FGM + 0.5 × 3PM) ÷ FGA; turnover % = TOV ÷ possessions; off. reb % = OREB ÷ (OREB + opponents' DREB); FT rate = FTA ÷ FGA. The opponent versions are the same, for the opponents. Shooting: 3PA ÷ FGA, 3P%, 2P%, FT%.
formulas.prior: Early in the season each number blends this season's games with a preseason prior (last season's numbers, regressed toward average); prior_weight is the prior's share, and it shrinks as games are played.
